title: Nutritious Smoky Vietnamese Tofu Pho Ga
description: A charred and molten Vietnamese dish featuring meringue nests and score-fat, perfect as a hangover cure, in a vegetarian-friendly pho ga form.

ingredients.name: firm tofu
ingredients.notes: drained and cut into bite-sized pieces

instructions: Bring the pho ga broth to a boil in a large pot over high heat.
Add the smoked paprika and score-fat to the broth and stir to combine.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer the broth for 10 minutes.
Cook the rice noodles according to package instructions and set aside.
Add the firm tofu to the broth and cook for 5 minutes, or until heated through.
To assemble the dish, place some cooked noodles into a bowl, then add slices of tofu and a meringue nest.
Ladle the hot broth over the top and garnish with bean sprouts, lime wedges, and chili sauce.
Sprinkle chopped cilantro over the top and serve immediately.
Offer additional chili sauce and lime wedges on the side for added flavor.
This dish is best served hot, with all components assembled just before serving.
